title: Integral trace duality and the Witt filtration on Lubin--Tate space
summary: Let $\mathcal O$ be the Lubin--Tate deformation ring of a one-dimensional commutative formal group of finite height $n\geq1$ over a perfect field $k$ of characteristic $p$. We identify Rezk's Witt filtration $\{I_d\}$ with the divisibility filtration of integral trace pairings on subgroup algebras of fixed source lifts. This gives the geometric recursion \[ I_{d+1}=pI_d+J_{d,z}\qquad(d\geq0), \] where $J_{d,z}$ defines the targets of order-$p^d$ quotient isogenies from a $W(k)$-valued lift $z$ of the closed point.
